text: lokasaññī hoti lokamānī ayaṃ vuccati ariyassa vinaye loko . kenevāvuso 1 lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī . cakkhunā kho āvuso lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī . sotena kho āvuso . ghānena kho āvuso . jivhāya kho āvuso lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī . kāyena kho āvuso . manena kho āvuso lokasmiṃ lokasaññī hoti lokamānī . yena kho āvuso lokasmiṃ #1 ma. yu. kenacāvuso . lokasaññī hoti lokamānī ayaṃ vuccati ariyassa vinaye loko . yaṃ kho vo āvuso
